newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa falls in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa falls in thin trading.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa followed New York down in thin trading, traders said.
Active December closed 11 stg down at 1,044 after opening one stg up on Wednesday's 1,055. Nearby September opened three stg up at 1,029 but ended 10 stg down at 1,016.
The March contract closed 14 sterling down at 1,064.
"The market is drifting in very thin trading. It's coming off against New York," a trader said.
"There's a lack of buying, basically and a few scattered sellers around."
Volume was 3,036 lots led by December with 967, September with 608 and March with 566. Traders said volumes were not expected to improve until the end of the month.
